Evaluate Lattice I by summing family primitive counts (3+4+5=12)

Reconstitute the full 144-element heteroskedastic POVM density matrix
Perform quantum state tomography to descend from SIC probabilities back to the density matrix ρ

Permanently record the exact d=12 fiducial amplitudes to sic_fiducial_d12.npy
Permanently record the 17,280,000 Crystal corpus size as the ML training bound
Seal the system within the trace-1 positive semidefinite boundary of valid quantum states
